Lemma constructive_sepcon_comm : forall P Q, P ** Q |-- Q ** P.
Proof.
  intros P Q h [h1 [h2 [Hjoin [HP HQ]]]].
  exists h2, h1.
  split; [| split; assumption].
  change (state_join h2 h1 h).
  change (state_join h1 h2 h) in Hjoin.
  unfold state_join in *.
  destruct Hjoin as [Hmem [Htoken Hsts]].

  - exact (mem_join_comm Hmem).

    + unfold TokenSet_join in *.
      sets_unfold in *.
      firstorder.
    + unfold STS_state_join in *.
      sets_unfold in *.
      firstorder.
Qed.
